You’ll be working with our popular home items, like chairs, tables, and cozy furniture, for both stores and online customers. Yes, it's active work with items up to 20 kg, but you don't have to do it alone! Our EPTs and Reachtrucks will help you with the heavy lifting. With easy digital scanners to track the stock, you'll work in a comfortable 2-shift rotation and earn up to €19.80 per hour. Ready to stay fit and work in a friendly team? Join us!

- Top pay up to €19.80 per hour!
- Higher salary based on your experience
- Tasty lunch options on early shifts
- Free breakfast every Tuesday & Thursday
- Get paid during your short breaks
- No heavy uniform—wear your own comfy clothes!

Who you are
As our Furniture Logistics Associate, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You can work in a 2 shift system ( 7.00-15.00 / 15.00 - 23.00 )
- You have your own transport to work in Sevenum/Venlo
- You are full time available

What will you do
Your main focus is getting our stunning furniture collection—from chic tables to cozy chairs—ready for stores and online customers. Welcome to a spacious, bright warehouse where Scandinavian design meets a great team spirit! At Søstrene Grene, you’ll join a supportive crew working in a comfortable 2-shift rotation. Even though you’re handling our heavier furniture items, you’ll have all the right tools—like EPTs and Reachtrucks—to make the job smooth and manageable

jobs.description:

In this role, you will work remotely from Portugal for a leading Dutch engineering company active in heavy lifting, offshore/marine cranes and hoisting equipment. Your responsibilities include: Creating electrical schematics in EPLAN Electric P8; Designing control cabinet layouts, terminal diagrams, cable lists and BOMs; Working on electrical systems for cranes, hoisting equipment and heavy lifting solutions; Supporting the selection of electrical components, sensors, drives and control systems; Working with motor control, VFDs, safety circuits, limit switches and load monitoring systems; Preparing technical documentation for production, commissioning and service; Reviewing and updating drawings based on project changes, client specifications or as-built information; Contributing to safe, reliable and maintainable electrical designs; Collaborating with international engineering teams in English. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will become part of Xelvin Portugal and work from our office in the Porto region. From Portugal, you will contribute to engineering projects for a Dutch customer, while being part of an international and growing engineering environment. We offer: Between 2000 and 2750 A challenging engineering role in offshore, marine and heavy lifting technology; The

opportunity to work for a leading Dutch company in high-end crane and hoisting equipment; A professional workplace in the Porto region; International collaboration with experienced engineers in the Netherlands; Room to grow technically and professionally; A role where your work directly contributes to safe and reliable lifting systems; Support from Xelvin Portugal during your onboarding and development. Functie-eisen We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical mindset and a practical approach to electrical design. Experience in heavy lifting or offshore/marine equipment is a plus, but not mandatory. Relevant experience in machine building, industrial automation, material handling, shipbuilding or heavy equipment is also highly valuable. You bring: At least 2 years of experience as an Electrical Design Engineer, EPLAN Engineer or similar; Good experience with EPLAN; A technical background in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a similar field; Experience with electrical schematics, control cabinets, cable lists, terminal diagrams and BOMs; Knowledge of industrial components such as drives, sensors, motors, safety relays, PLC I/O and control systems; An interest in working on cranes, hoisting systems and heavy lifting equipment; Good communication skills in English; A structured and accurate way of working; The ability to work independently while staying connected to an international project team. jobs.description:
As a dishwasher in Thermo Fisher's corporate restaurant, you are the hero of the scullery. You ensure that everything runs smoothly, the tableware shines, and your catering colleagues are never without clean equipment.

What we offer
- €14.99 per hour
- €0.23 per km starting from the first 10 km
- Pleasant working hours
- Plenty of training courses available for you
- Money in your account every week. Nice!
- Flexible, work whenever it suits you

Who you are
Physically fit: You are active throughout your shift, on your feet, and lift crates or stacks of tableware with ease.

Go-getter: You keep a cool head and maintain an overview, even during the hectic lunch peak.

Team player: You communicate well with kitchen colleagues to know which equipment has the highest priority.

Support: Lending a hand in the restaurant or with light kitchen prep work (such as chopping vegetables) when dish volume permits.
